⭐ Welcome to Anime Power Tycoon!

This is a combat-based tycoon game inspired by some animes / mangas. Unlock Anime Powers and build your own power tycoon🏗️ to fight your enemies⚔️ and friends. Kill boss and get rewards. Become stronger and richer💸 to be the best on the server!

PREMIUM PLAYERS GET EXTRA CASH + SPECIAL SKILL!
GROUP MEMBERS GET EXTRA CASH!
Lagging? USE A FREE VIP SERVER ❤️
This game has AUTO SAVE! Each tycoon is saved separately. 💾

Share the game with your friends and have fun! 👥
